mmgrw.tooltip: Measure this world and try individual reductions until your target is met. Outside a world, estimate from hardware. Tune... sets your goal and offers gameplay learning. Restore undoes tuning.
mmgrw.limit.memory: Hardware estimate limited by system or allocated memory.
mmgrw.limit.cpu: Hardware estimate limited by processor speed or core count.
mmgrw.limit.gpu: Hardware estimate limited by graphics hardware or resolution.
mmgrw.limit.config: Held back by this installation's makemygamerunwell.json.
mmgrw.limit.benchmark: Selected individual reductions after measuring their effect.
mmgrw.basis.benchmarked: Benchmarked at about %s fps in this world.
mmgrw.basis.no_world: Estimated from your hardware. Open Options from inside a world to benchmark.
mmgrw.basis.unavailable: Estimated from your hardware: the benchmark could not run.
mmgrw.tuning.title: Make My Game Run Well
mmgrw.goal.smooth.tooltip: Aim for steady gameplay, with extra benchmark headroom for busy scenes.
mmgrw.goal.beautiful.tooltip: Keep more detail by accepting less benchmark headroom. Busy scenes may fall below your target.
mmgrw.goal.quiet.tooltip: Require more spare performance, then cap FPS to reduce unnecessary work. Temperature and battery life are not measured.
mmgrw.target.tooltip: Applies on your next tune. Frame caps round up to Minecraft's next step of ten. The config fpsLimit override takes priority.
mmgrw.learning.tooltip: Observe up to two minutes of active play without changing settings. Menus and unfocused time do not count. Return here to review an untested suggestion.
mmgrw.learning.unavailable: Join a world to learn; see log if it fails.
mmgrw.learning.ready: Gameplay sample ready. Open Options > Tune to review.
mmgrw.learning.smooth: Your current settings met the target.
mmgrw.learning.capped: Your FPS cap or VSync is below the target.
mmgrw.learning.try_reduction: Below target. This suggestion is untested.
mmgrw.learning.at_floor: No further supported reductions. Target missed.
mmgrw.learning.applied: Reduction applied. Learn again to compare.
mmgrw.learning.stale: Sample expired or apply failed. Learn again.
mmgrw.target.met: Met the benchmark target in this scene.
mmgrw.target.missed: Target not reached. No FPS improvement is promised.
mmgrw.basis.gameplay: Suggested from previous gameplay; new settings are untested.
mmgrw.hardware_changed: Your %s changed since the last tune. Tuning again may help.
mmgrw.shader_pack: A shader pack was active, so its cost is part of this measurement and these settings cannot reduce it.
mmgrw.memory.too_small: Memory: about %s MB would suit this render distance. Raise Minecraft's allocation in your launcher.
mmgrw.memory.too_large: Memory: Minecraft's allocation leaves little for your system. About %s MB is safer.
mmgrw.changes.tooltip: See every setting this mod changed, put one back, or copy a report for a bug report.
mmgrw.changes.title: Changed settings
mmgrw.changes.none: This mod has not changed any of your settings.
mmgrw.changes.revert_failed: Could not put it back; see log.
mmgrw.changes.copy_failed: Could not copy the report; see log.
